16.synopsis: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and the weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger.  Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything.  His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancée suddenly shown up?

528.synopsis:
Preying on the dreams of human beings, but also giving its host supernatural powers are the Mushi, which have appeared for a decade. Kusuriya Daisuke, while on the train to school, comes across a girl named Shiika and that meeting sparked an attraction between the two.
However, Shiika was a MushiTsuki who had escaped from the countrys top secret facility. Due to that reason, the Special Environmental Prevention Bureau had dispatched their top and strongest agent, the MushiTsuki known as “Kakkou” on a mission to mercilessly eliminate Shiika.
The people who are harboring dreams, and the painful but strong wishes in them, are about to enjoy the coming Christmas.
This is the Encounter of a Boy and his meeting with a Girl.
The Most Beautiful yet Disastrous story of this Fateful Encounter

1808.synopsis:
Balsa the spearwoman is a wandering warrior, who takes on the task of saving lives, in atonement for a past sin. On her journey, she happens to save a prince, and is tasked with becoming his bodyguard. And he is going to need one, for his own father, the emperor, wants him dead.
Batchelder Award Winner

3856.synopsis:
Although I was longing to live in a different world, when I actually got there it wasn’t an easy thing as I thought.
Generally, If I go to different world, the most noticing thing would be the field of forest right?
But suddenly I fell on a conference table.
From the clothes of the people who arrested me, I thought this was probably different world. The survivor of a knights order of destroyed country seems to be deciding what to do from now on.
They seems to want to restore the kingdom back. What a serious bunch.
When the princess show up, they were discussing their future plan. Then I give some slight advice and was set as their adviser.
The suggestion I gave was to become a bandit. I wondered if the guys who were knights of the kingdom could become bandits…
The final goal to revive the kingdom was a rocky path. However, it should be expected. 
Even if I found a job in this world, I am still a NEET. They seemed to have taken care of food, clothing and shelter too.
The future was long, the moral of the knight seems to be high. Surprisingly it might go well…
associated_names: Sanzoku yo, taishi o idake. Ōkoku saikō o nashitogeru tame ni!
山賊よ、大志を抱け。王国再興を成し遂げるために！

5392.synopsis:
One day, 22-year-old Kanzaki Misuzu is suddenly transported to a strange world. Based on the pop-up screens she can access, it seems she’s entered some kind of RPG as a magic user!
Luckily, she can use the gaming skills she acquired as an otaku to make her way in this new world. But before she knows it, people start calling her “the Black Healer”!!
associated_names: In Another World I'm called The Black Healer
異世界で 黒の癒し手 って呼ばれています

7696.synopsis: Tarou was just an ordinary university student until a strange old magician summoned him to another world. Upon learning that his newly acquired magical power is 8 million (8 million more powerful than an average magician), he uses his abnormally powerful magic to revive the old man that caused all this… in the form of a frog. Thus begin the strange adventures of a boy with ridiculous magical power and Kawazu, the former strongest magician, now revived as a frog.
associated_names: Chronicles of My Adventures in Another World With Kawazu-san
俺と蛙さんの異世界放浪記

9232.synopsis:
The old family falling into ruin-the Seikanji family. The eldest son, Kunitaka, is by chance reunited with his childhood friend, Ryouichirou, the son of a servant. The pair were separated from each other by a trivial misunderstanding, and from their reunion, Kunitaka, leading a constrained life, seeks comfort in Ryouichirou, and is drawn to him.
However, Ryouichirou has a grave secret, one that is a matter of life and death. Kunitaka, upon knowing this, offers his body to Ryouichirou, trying to save him…

11536.synopsis: Sagimiya Keita is a heavy gamer of MMORPG without experience with girls. In his favorite game, he controls a female character, like most of the members of his guild. But when it comes to offline meetings, Keita plays the role of the “The Knight-sama”, the only male character of the guild. He became famous in real life as in virtual life! The romantic comedy between the real world and the virtual one begins!
associated_names: 俺のリアルとネトゲがラブコメに侵蝕され始めてヤバイ

13072.synopsis:
I had known for most of my life that I would be killed by a Yandere and now, that day has finally come — or that should have been what happened. Instead, I was reincarnated by a Goddess in a game-like world.
I jumped at the opportunity to live a normal, peaceful life with ordinary girls… Now I have a skill that awakens Yanderes!? The world the Goddess created specializes in Yanderes!?
On top of that, in order to gain a certain cheat ability, I was born with a body that can’t harm women no matter what they do to me… I wanted a peaceful life in this world, but it seems even in a different world I will be loved to death by Yanderes.
associated_names: Even in a different world, I’m being loved to death by Yanderes
Kono Isekai demo, Yandere ni Shinu hodo Aisareru
この異世界でも、ヤンデレに死ぬほど愛される

16144.synopsis:
Iruma Takumi, a 40-year old salary man, was dragged into a hero summoning just like in a template. What was his fate? The Goddess sent him and the heroes to the other world separately.
With the Goddess’ overprotective support, he landed in a different world looking handsome, rejuvenated, and quite different from a Japanese.
Although he wanted a slow life while working in the manufacturing trade, that was not permitted by the Goddess’ special body and abilities.
Would Takumi be able to live a peaceful life in a different world?
associated_names: Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time
いずれ最強の錬金術師？

17680.synopsis:
A no-name writer becomes the personal assistant to a famous web novelist, and moves in with him amidst much bickering. He freeloads off the successful novelist, eats the novelist’s food, lives in the novelist’s house, and, eventually, even sleeps in the novelist’s bed.
A certain no-name writer (flipping a table): “It was totally that bastard who forced me to—Mmph! Mmph! Mmph! Oi, Su Yuyang, why’re you covering my mouth?”
The successful novelist (whispering into the no-name writer’s ear): “Xiao Miao, I’m hungry.”
Enjoy the simple pleasures of the everyday with an oddball novelist and his dumb cat.

19216.synopsis:
One day, the engagement between the Second Prince Arnight and his fiancee, Veena Lilyfall, was broken off.
However, despite it being the cause of the disengagement, she has no memories of ever bullying that girl.
No matter how groundless the accusations were, when Lady Lilyfall’s fall from grace was announced to the public, the wolves in the hall with their cold glares began to see her as easy prey. Only the Princess, younger sibling to Prince Arnight, didn’t seem to fully understand the situation.
The Princess sought to protect Veena, and together they escaped.
associated_names: 悪役令嬢、百合に目覚める

20752.synopsis:
Lin Yixue, standing above: “Well, I helped you save a person Can I ask for a small request?”
Ouyang Zhixuan’s eyelid lifted, with a quite giving face: “Speak!”
Lin Yixue eyes narrowed, in a good mood she presented: “My family has a meimei, her name is Yi Shuang, her appearance is beautiful and alluring, with a gentle disposition, and dignified virtue….”
Ouyang Zhixuan unhurriedly rapped on the desk, with a force to oppress Lin Yixue: “Get to the point!”
Lin Yixue did not notice: “E…. I do not want to be Tai Zi Fei (Crown Prince’s Wife), let Yi Shuang do it okay?”
Ouyang Zhixuan’s fingers stopped, pulled Lin Yixue and locked her in his embrace, a strong kiss fell on her lips, overbearingly nibbling her lips, as he angrily s**ked….it is only until he sensed Lin Yixue gasp for air, did he let her go.
With a low and hoarse voice, he spoke: “Say another nonsense, This prince does not mind to immediately proceed to the bridal chambers!”

21520.synopsis:
Zhou Xu, an interstellar military counselor, was selected by the “will not die in peace” system, and as a result, even though he had a great fear of pain, began his journey as the villain, forced to die a terrible death over and over again. Zhou Xu, after going through a hundred worlds and dying a hundred times, finally changed. He wanted to retaliate!
When Zhou Xu crossed for the 101st time, an error occurred in the system.
Zhou Xu, ready for revenge, seized the opportunity, and at last, placed the system under his control.
Haha, Zhou Xu laughed. The villain had always been killed by the protagonist. Now, he would like to see who killed who.
Cruel and merciless shou vs domineering bully gong
associated_names: Vai ác vả mặt nghịch tập

22288.synopsis:
Imagine having the opportunity to be able to enter different worlds created by numerous novels and stories. Which kind of role would you like to play?
Do you want to be the illustrious protagonist, either good or evil, or just be a supporting role standing behind the protagonists?
Our villainess boss, Ming Shu, would choose none of the above. Claiming missions from the Harmony System and driven by her endless passion for snacks, the world traveler, Ming Shu, embarks on the path to make the mission target hate her as much as possible by gaining Hatred Points. But it turns out she is not alone on her journey…
associated_names: Hệ Thống Xuyên Nhanh: Boss Phản Diện Đột Kích

22800.synopsis:
I have experienced all the eight sufferings of this world.
I do not ask for nirvana, but for you.
Wild and hard-to-tame demon (gong) X Cold, ascetic and childish immortal (shou)

23312.synopsis:
Lin Qingqing was still talking to her friends about taking part in the singing contest the previous night. When she woke up the next day, she came five years later and found that she had not only married an overbearing president she didn’t know at all, but also had a child with him?!!
What kind of dog blood plot is this?
It is said that she still doesn’t like her husband and children, and the most thing she wants to do every day is divorce.
Looking at the pitiful eyes of Little Meng dumpling that was looking for attention and care in front of her, the handsome and rich, carefully spoiled her, want to get close but dare not, her overbearing husband, Lin Qingqing heart felt soft, “just accept it”!
At first Lin Qingqing only wanted to be a good mother, but later she found the husband so charming that she only wanted to roll in his arms every day….
Yi Zeyan knew from the beginning that the woman did not love him. No matter how kind he was to her, she didn’t appreciate it. Even if she married him, she was not willing to look him in the eye. Later, she simply lost her memory and completely forgot him.
However, he did not expect her to become different after losing her memory. She not only did not reject his approach, but even smiled at him. Later, she even stuck close to him from time to time and acted like a spoiled child to him.
She has become so sweet, how can he endure it…
associated_names: She Became Both Alluring and Sweet
She Has Become Flirty and Sweet

24336.synopsis:
From Crimson Translations:
A story of a substitute marriage with a happy ending.
Includes childbirth.
Excerpt:
Qing Shi Jiu, true to his reputation as someone who couldn’t handle more than two drinks, started climbing onto Ling Shan Jun for kisses after just one cup of light wine. As the kissing continued, he pushed Ling Shan Jun onto the bed and began stripping off his own clothes.
It was another night where he ended up crying pitifully from being bullied.
The next day, when Qing Shi Jiu woke up still fuming, Ling Shan Jun placed a document in front of him. The crooked handwriting was unmistakably his own style, and there was even a signature and a red fingerprint at the bottom right corner.
Qing Shi Jiu glanced over the contents of the document: “…”
Ling Shan Jun smiled mischievously. “This document serves as proof. Last night, you offered yourself willingly, so you can’t throw a tantrum at me over it.”
Qing Shi Jiu became even angrier.
Ling Shan Jun’s eyes were filled with a smile, and the handsome face that usually left Qing Shi Jiu utterly captivated now seemed particularly irritating. “Madam, we agreed that you wouldn’t be angry. Don’t you remember? Last night, I intended for it to be just once, but you kept clinging to me…”
Qing Shi Jiu, unable to bear it any longer, sealed that annoying mouth with his own.

25360.synopsis:
A s*upid father with good luck, a kick-ass and protective mother, and a dandy younger brother all want a principal husband. 
Her engagement has been broken off three times yet she does not panic. 
Beautiful and magnificent clothes, golden beams in their house. 
She has money, she has power, why would she need a husband? 
This is a story about a garish woman who has had her engagement broken off three times and a hypocrite of a man.
associated_names: I Am This Kind of Woman
ข้าก็เป็นสตรีเช่นนี้

26128.synopsis:
I noticed him 10 million years after I woke up.
When I was born, the Milkyway was still a young galaxy – of course, it is also young today, and the existing universe is only 14 billion years old. Everything is new. I’m at the edge of the galaxy, closest to other galaxies.
That’s why I noticed him.

28944.synopsis:
In high school, Xu Chang was Qin Xiangnan’s nightmare.
Ten years later, he unexpectedly appeared in front of her and confessed to her.
Qin Xiangnan: How could a prideful guy like you take a fancy on me?
Xu Chang: Why? Haven’t you forgotten Shen Zhiyang?
Fortunately, you are still waiting for me. Fortunately, you also like me.
A story of a hard-working journalist woman and a handsome male doctor.

29456.synopsis: As soon as she fell into the world of beastmen, a leopard forcibly took her back to his home. Indeed, Bai Qingqing is at a complete and utter loss. The males in this world are all handsome beyond compare, while the women are all so horrid that even the gods shudder at their sight. As a first-rate girl from the modern world (she’s also a quarter Russian), Bai Qingqing finds herself sitting at the center of a harem filled with beautiful men — at the very peak of existence.
associated_names: 悠哉兽世：种种田，生生崽

29712.synopsis:
Grey Millard was born as the third son of the poorest aristocrat in the empire. In the Millard territory of the empire lives its feudal lord, Grey’s father. However, his father is being controlled by his fiendish stepmother. Disliking this kind of trouble, Grey is immediately determined to leave the Millard territory. Until Grey severs his relationship with his parents at 13, he devotes his entirety on self-improvement, ignoring those suffering under his stepmother’s tyrannical rule. But…
This is the adventure of a boy with the mind of a middle-aged man.
associated_names: Karada Wa Jidou, Nakami Wa Ossan No Nariagari Boukenki
The Adventure Of Boy With A Mind Of A Middle Aged Man
身体は児童、中身はおっさんの成り上がり冒険記

30480.synopsis: After getting into an accident, Ji Xiaobei’s world turned dark and gloomy, all until one day, he was introduced to an app which aided the blind. Through his daily communications with Chen Zhuo on the app, the two started to develop mutual dependency on each other. However, when Ji Xiaobei discovered that Chen Zhuo was the creator of the app, he started distancing himself away from him.

32272.synopsis:
One day, Katrea, the youngest and only daughter of a countryside noble received a suspicious marriage offer from one of the most prestigious aristocratic family in the country, the Vrag family. 
Blinded by his good looks, wealth and closeness in age, all these great conditions, Katrea agreed without a second thought. However, the Duke appeared particularly cold towards her on their first meeting, like he was completely uninterested in his bride. And on the day of their wedding, she overheard the Duke mocking her family with his friends. 
Enrage by that, Katrea exploded and refused to engage in the various activities of a wedding night. But she was eventually forced into his bedroom and died before she could process what had happened. 
「Eh? I came back to life?」
She should be dead, but when she opened her eyes, she had somehow gone back in time, right before she left for the Duke’s bedroom. Katrea actually looped back on the worst wedding night ever!
Every time she died, she would loop back to the start of this terrible night.
Can this simple-minded Ojou-sama overcome the deathloop?
associated_names: 結婚初夜のデスループ〜脳筋令嬢は何度死んでもめげません〜

32784.synopsis:
“Please marry me.”
Sei, who was just twenty years old, asks Min-hyuk to marry her without any hesitation.
“Does Yun-sei want to marry me?”
“Yes.”
“But you and I are nine years apart.”
“So what? Is it illegal?”
Min-hyuk is embarrassed by her unbelievably calm and stubborn attitude  towards her her age.
Eventually, the two marry each other according to the interests of their families and not for the needs of each other.
Saying that she would live like a doll, she stays with Min-hyuk quietly throughout her marriage.
Minhyuk always feels curious and compassion from his wife who acts like an adult, and finds out that there are secrets she wants to hide from him.
One day, when she had unknowingly occupied a larger portion in Min-hyuk’s heart, she said.
“Please divorce me.”

33808.synopsis:
The youthful Qin Ye was born almost a century ago, but thanks to immortality granted to him by the ‘fungus of aeons’ he can pass for a high schooler.
He planned to live an eternal, reclusive life as a happy otaku, enjoying World of Warcraft and his favorite MOBA games, but Fate had other plans in store.  
Hell has broken down, and vengeful revenants stalk the mortal realms.  With ghosts running amok throughout all of Cathay, Qin Ye must reluctantly adopt the mantle of ‘hero’ and bring peace to both the living and the dead, while rebuilding Hell.  
But this, of course, isn’t something a mere Netherworld Operative can do.  For that, he’ll need to become more.
King Yama is dead.  Long live King Yama!

35088.synopsis: It was so hard for her to make a choice when she saw the two naked bodies in the bed…
associated_names: 豪门婚宠：邪魅总裁小娇妻

36112.synopsis:
GuWang transmigrated into a danmei novel were the original owner of the body had died after chasing the white moonlight.
Convinced that he could now escape this fate, he is determined to not interfered between the male lead and the white moonlight. 
But, what are all those flashbacks? Why does it seem that things aren’t what they were supposed to be ? 
It’s a psychological slow pace love story about redemption : 
I didn’t know how to love you in our previous life,
I made you the best without me,
Our change is our redemption.
I’m pathologically obsessed with you but willing to change for your /our happiness (ML) X I’m better without you but can’t leave you behind when you are willing to change (MC)
associated_names: I am attracted to the male lead's white moonlight
Tôi bị ánh trăng của nam chính coi trọng
我被男主的白月光看上了［穿书］

39440.synopsis:
She died because of the prince, and it’s her fourth return.
I can’t die again.
The prince…
Let’s seduce him!
***
“Tell me again. What we talked about back then.”
The blood stained Castian looked at Earendel and said,
“I like you. I’m serious. You said that, didn’t you?” Earendel finally realized.
“So if I save your life, tell me you’ll be with me for the rest of your life.”
That something has been twisted.

39696.synopsis:
Yukata, our pro gamer protagonist, was sent to another world one day. During that time, he was given a unique skill that was tailored just for him.
「If you do well with the puzzle game that’s displayed in the window, you will be able to shoot out powerful magic」
Taking advantage of the game skills he has cultivated, he quickly mastered that skill. And while making use of that skill and living freely in a another world … Yukata ended up becoming the strongest hero in the world.
associated_names: スライム召喚無双　～ゲーム技術は異世界でも最強なようです～

40208.synopsis: Being reborn to when she was 18, Su Mian made a solemn vow to use her medical expertise for the benefit of humanity. “Wife, I’m by your side. Why not benefit me first…”. Before she had been reborn, Su Mian had willfully married a perverse tr*sh of a man and wronged Commander Wei for 30 years. This time, Su Mian constantly thought about marrying Commander Wei…… In this life time, Commander Wei treated this wife with three words: love, love, and LOVE!

44304.synopsis:
I am an ordinary high school student, Shingo Fujishima, and I have a childhood friend who is known as a divine actress in the world.
We live in different worlds now, but she seems to be dependent on me and still comes to stay at my house often.
We are very close, but she is just a childhood friend. From my point of view, she is like a sister to me.
One day, she told me that she wanted to practice a kissing scene, and I realized my feelings for her.
associated_names: Kami Joyu no Osananajimi wa naze ka Heibon na Ore ni Izon Shiteiru
神女優の幼馴染はなぜか平凡な俺に依存している

44560.synopsis:
My absolute favourite character from my previous life became my stepbrother from my mother’s remarriage. This world is that of a nurturing simulation otome game. My stepbrother was a capture target in that game.
And I became the younger brother from his memories, the one who only appeared in his personal story and was supposed to die soon!
‘Honestly, I don’t care if the younger brother of my absolute fave dies! But no, I can’t die until I see my absolute fave grow up! I’ll live! I’m going to smash the death flags and adore my absolute fave today as well!’
This is the story of a reincarnated younger brother in an otome game and his struggles with all of his death flags.
associated_names: Sai Oshi no Gikei o Mederu Tame, Nagaiki Shimasu!
最推しの義兄を愛でるため、長生きします！

46864.synopsis:
As a second year high school student, I, Kotaro Yagami, was planning to spend my days as normal as ever.
But that day, a new student arrived in my class, and that new student was my childhood friend, Tsukishima Yui, whom I prommised to marry a long time ago.
It was when we were kids, so I’m sure she’s forgotten about it….? But she remembered and confessed her love for me in front of everyone
There was also some kind of unsettling atmosphere with Asuka Shirakawa, who was in the same club……
It seems that my peaceful school life came to an end on this day.
associated_names: Uchi no Class ni Yattekita Bishoujo Tenkousei no Shoutai ga, Mukashi Ookiku Nattara Kekkon Shiyou to Yakusoku Shita Osananajimi deshita.
うちのクラスにやってきた美少女転校生の正体が、昔大きくなったら結婚しようと約束した幼馴染でした。

48656.synopsis:
Andou Shougo, a normal high school student you can find anywhere, had one day died after a falling meteorite hit and destroyed his skull.
When he came to, he was in a completely white world.
There, he met a girl claiming herself to be God, ordering him to go and defeat a Demon Lord in another world.
“There’s no way I’d be able to do that.”
“If you are able to defeat the Demon Lord, I will grant you whatever you desire.”
“…!”
In order to get the Goddess to grant him a certain wish, Andou decided to accept and defeat the Demon Lord. After 10 years, he finally won the decisive battle against such an adversary on an isolated island at the furthest ends of the world.
“Come, Goddess! I have defeated the Demon Lord as promised! Now, it’s your turn to fulfill the other side of the bargain and grant me my wish!”
“You have done well in defeating the Demon Lord, Shougo-san. Now, tell me what it is that you wish, I will make it come true whatever it may be.”
After having his wish conveyed to the Goddess, Andou finds himself back in Japan, at the time just before he was reincarnated.
Moreover, the power he had acquired as a hero in the other world remained.
“Isn’t the current me just like superman…?”
Holding a power that could destroy the whole world if he so desired, Andou goes about living his daily life as usual.
However, one day, dungeons had suddenly appeared in the peaceful nation of Japan.
“Dungeons have appeared above grounds, and the country has begun running an adventurer’s guild in order to excavate resources found within… If that’s the case, then I might be able to use my power as a hero.”
In Modern Japan where dungeons have started appearing, Andou, the sole human who can use ancient magic, finds himself living to his heart’s content and satisfaction with his acquired money and fame.
associated_names: After defeating the demon king in another world and returning to Japan, a dungeon appeared on the ground.
異世界で魔王を倒して日本に帰ってきたら、地上にダンジョンが出現しました

50448.synopsis: Chevaldin is a wandering sorcerer who is annoyed by people who call him one of the ‘Three Wise Men’. After questioning the methods of the Maldegar Academy of Magic founded by his brother Zephyr, Chevaldin reincarnates as a 17-year-old boy and infiltrates the academy. Eventually, he discovers the secrets of the academy and sets out to reform it with his friends, but this leads to an endless war with the neighboring Beogranz Empire. Guns and magic collide on the battlefield in this school and war fantasy.
associated_names: Senpuku Kenja wa Hisomenai: Wakagaeri Inja no Gakuin Senki
潜伏賢者は潜めない ～若返り隠者の学院戦記～

51216.synopsis:
Tens of thousands of demons in this world roam; half call the city of Zhaoye home. As for the other half, they’ve all died in the Canglang Northern Territory controlled by the Tianxiu Immortal Xiao Fuxuan. 
Only one demon has been imprisoned for twenty-five years and still lives—the lord of Zhaoye City, Wu Xingxue.
associated_names: An Immortal's Absence, Three Centuries Hence
Ba trăm năm vắng bóng thượng tiên
Three Hundred Years of Longing (Official English Title)
สามร้อยเหมันต์ มิพานพบท่านเซียน

51984.synopsis:
Jeonghan meets his cousin Il-Jo, who he almost forgot existed, at his uncle’s funeral. Feeling sympathy for the impoverished Il-Jo, Jeonghan impulsively suggests to live together, which he soon regrets.
“What are you doing?”
“…….”
“What do you have to say for yourself.”
He asked because he discovered Il-Jo secretly trying to kiss him while he was asleep. Jeonghan attempts to kick out Il-Jo but, in the end, fails to do so. Instead, he asks how Il-Jo can get rid of his unrequited feelings.
“Just kiss me once.”
“If I do that, will that help you like me less?”
On the pretext of sympathy, Jeonghan slowly gave his heart to Il-Jo. Before he knows it, he finds himself to be sexually involved and possessive over him.

53264.synopsis:
The arrogant man who seeks perfection, hotel CEO Min SeonJae.
The woman who expresses the shape of love, hearing-impaired florist Lee YeonJung.
He finally realized why he put the woman inside his car at the parking lot as if he was kidnapping her. It wasn’t out of sympathy. He had never once felt sympathy for anyone in the thirty-two years of his life. 
He was sexually attracted to her. Unbelievably attracted.
“I’m… using you righ’ now, you know.”
“It doesn’t matter.”
No matter what it took, he wanted to leave traces of himself in her silent world.

53776.synopsis:
“Alicia Filta, I break my engagement with you!”
said Raymond-sama, the son of the Duke of Jaeger. On Raymond-sama’s arm was Miranda-sama, the Baroness’ daughter. Miranda-sama was a pretty, sheltered girl with pink downy hair, big red eyes, and a petite stature.
I, on the other hand, have silver hair and violet eyes, and my facial expression is not as expressive, which is why I am called the “Princess of Noh Masks” or “the Doll Princess.”
No wonder Raymond-sama is attracted to Miranda-sama…. But…
“You’re jealous of my fondness for the kind-hearted and beautiful Miranda, and you’ve torn up Miranda’s school books, pushed her down the stairs, and committed other violent acts!”
“Excuse me?! Can I talk to you for a minute?”
“What?”
Raymond-sama frowns and stares at me.
“You’re breaking off your engagement with me? It was done yesterday, didn’t you know?!”
At my words, Raymond-sama and Miranda-sama looked at each other in shock.
associated_names: 「婚約破棄ですか？　それなら昨日成立しましたよ、ご存知ありませんでしたか？」

54800.synopsis:
Jiang Yuan has long hair which is as beautiful as a waterfall and recently a strange thing happened to her. What Yu Sui didn’t know was that Shi Yanzhi had fallen for her at first sight and had secretly been in love with her for ten years. The moment he returned to the country, his goal was to pluck this delicate flower and place her in his own vase.

106768.synopsis:
Yudit, you must survive.”
The frail Fifth Prince, Yudit, was barely clinging to life, his existence tolerated only because of his sickly constitution and his mother’s lowly origins. Following his mother’s dying wish, he lived quietly, keeping his head down to survive.
Then one day, Duke Baldwin, who had been secretly asked to kill him, appeared before him in person. Yet, rather than cower before the sword, Yudit boldly declared that he would become a puppet emperor—and insisted that Duke Baldwin should choose him.
[Preview] 
“Your Grace?”
A chill ran down Yudit’s neck—he had just dreamed of being cut down by this very man.
“You were talking about me in your dream.”
“Is that so?”
“What kind of dream was it?”
“I forgot.”
“You said you liked me.”
For a moment, Yudit was about to say, That’s a lie, but he stopped himself. He had just claimed that he didn’t remember the dream.
“That’s a lie.”
Khalid, who had been watching him closely, spoke the very words Yudit had wanted to say.
“You were begging me to let you live.”
“……”
“I hope you work hard and survive. I really enjoy my time with you.”

108560.synopsis:
I was supposed to meet her again in 10 years.
But I got kidnapped by the Demonic Sect.

112912.synopsis:
“My dream is to heal in the countryside.”
He never imagined that a single line he said nine years ago would light the fuse.
Because of the debt left behind by his father, he’s kidnapped by Cha Minhyung—an executive of a mafia-run corporation—and confined to a secluded countryside estate.
Three full meals a day, cozy bedding, overly kind(?) people, and the freedom to do whatever he wants in a luxurious villa…
“I told you to just relax. Why won’t you listen?”

113168.synopsis:
A life full of potential, derailed by a golden spoon parachutist. 
[“Would you like to start the New Life Game?”] 
A mobile game I downloaded without much thought changed my life. 
From a dirt-poor office worker to a chaebol’s golden spoon?

118288.synopsis:
The embodiment of incompetence in the original novel and the cause of its anticlimactic ending. 
A troublesome character who disappeared through adaptation in the webtoon, he was reincarnated as ‘Kafka Sonder.’
He has memories of his past life, so he could try to change fate if he wanted to… But he has no energy, no motivation, and couldn’t care less whether the world ends or not.
So he tried to live quietly like a dead mouse, doing absolutely nothing.
‘Why is he manifesting an aura now?’
Even when the plot flows differently than expected, 
“Let’s go somewhere quiet and have a little chat.” 
Even when he keep running into ‘Soren,’ the protagonist he wanted to avoid most.
He had to remember his resolution to never get involved…
“You’re saying you’ll give up on defeating the Demon King because of me alone?” 
“Yeah. It’d be perfect if we all die and meet in hell, don’t you think?”
The disaster that came the moment he got greedy for a happy ending. 
At the end of this chaos he brought upon himself, what kind of ending will this world face?
associated_names: Cái Kết Của Thế Giới Này, Tôi Chẳng Mảy May Bận Tâm
이 세계의 결말 따윈 아무래도 좋았다

118544.synopsis:
The person who saved him from his oppressive father was Han Soo-hyeok, who had rejected Lee Si-woo at their arranged meeting.
A few years later, having fled empty-handed and settled somewhere new, 
Lee Si-woo heard news of Han Soo-hyeok’s marriage. 
Wanting to see his face one last time, he went to find him, but the moment he caught sight of him and turned to leave, he died in a traffic accident.
And when he opened his eyes, he was back at the arranged meeting with Han Soo-hyeok.
“I don’t want to let go of you, Han Soo-hyeok.” 
“Are you asking me to marry you?” 
“Not marriage—employment.”
Though he ended up in a contract relationship due to circumstances, Lee Si-woo makes a resolution to eventually return him to his future marriage partner.
“For the sake of our broken engagement, I’ll become the villain!”

120080.synopsis:
After leaving the Taoist temple, Gu Wang was forced to inherit a dilapidated amusement park.
Staring at the half-collapsed wall and crooked main gate, he just wanted to look up at the sky and wail, “Even ghosts wouldn’t want to come to this dump! Forget tourists, I can’t even get enough staff!”
Suddenly, a pale green face poked out from beside him. “Who says we don’t want to come? We’ve lived here for hundreds of years!”
Gu Wang: “…Oh.”
Gu Wang: “…Huh?”
A few days later, a rumor started circulating on social media: a new supernatural-themed amusement park had opened in the suburbs. Rumor has it that stepping inside is an immersive experience, and the staff are all total pros—they even float when they walk!
And apparently, their VR experience hall had world-leading tech, so realistic it felt like time travel, and the staff all wore fox ears!
They also said the forest-themed area was stunningly beautiful, and the small animals there were clever, brave, and surprisingly human-like. Plus, they loved the smell of incense!
And it’s said that…
Gu Wang: I’m here now, and I can confirm, it’s all true.
–
To expand the park’s offerings, a grand new stage was constructed. The ghosts formed a performance troupe, but they were missing one thing: a handsome lead actor.
The ghosts began, “Maybe we should hire a…”
Gu Wang grabbed his peach wood sword. “Hire what? I’ll go catch one myself! Is a thousand-year-old succubus good enough? What about a skin-painter?”
Three days later, Gu Wang returned with his captured, stunning “leading lady.”
The ghosts shivered uncontrollably. “Lord… Lord of the Underworld…”
associated_names: 开灵异游乐园后我成了万人迷
继承鬼屋但员工都不是人

122896.synopsis:
Dungeons suddenly appears in modern-day Japan.
The protagonist, who dives into them, ends up trapped inside for 25 whole years.
While trying to escape, he happens to save a popular streamer girl, who in turn helps him make it back to the surface.
But a lot can change in 25 years.
Harsh new laws.
Countless things lost after vanishing for so long.
Common sense forgotten after years of surviving in the wild.
And now, without warning, he’s thrown into the world of streaming.
This is the story of a man who isn’t a hero or a celebrity—
just a regular person who easily gets swept up by his surroundings—
as he returns from the abyss… and dives once more into fierce battles within the dungeon.
associated_names: ダンジョンに閉じ込められて２５年。救出されたときには立派な不審者になっていた

123408.synopsis:
Chu Xinghui, the most talented young cultivator in the ten-mile radius, was struck by a bolt of heavenly lightning on his way to the cultivation world. Suddenly, he had an epiphany: he realized he was the second male lead in a cultivation novel, the “foolish dog” who serves as the main character’s sidekick.
According to the plot, after joining Lingxiang Sect as a disciple, he would be recognized as the long-lost son of the sect leader, who had disappeared many years ago. However, since the sect leader already had other children, Chu Xinghui would be ignored and despised by everyone. Only the protagonist would throw him a candy, and then he would resolutely become the protagonist’s loyal dog, ultimately dying for the protagonist, blocking a sword to save them. After death, he would finally gain the forgiveness of all his “family members” and be honored with a burial in the family’s ancestral tomb.
Chu Xinghui was shocked by this wild plot. After thinking for a moment, he tore up the application letter to join Lingxiang Sect and turned to leave with his luggage.
“Scary. Who cares about this s*upid plot? I’ll do my own thing. I’d rather focus on cultivating and ascending as soon as possible.”
He weighed the sword in his hand, deciding to be a wandering rogue cultivator for the time being.
However, within two days of being a wandering cultivator, he was forcefully picked up by a weak, powerless ordinary person who couldn’t even manage their own life.
associated_names: The Second Male Lead Ran Away on the Spot

125456.synopsis:
In the eighth year of my marriage, I encountered my first love and asked my billionaire husband for a divorce.
With the 2 billion assets my ex-husband divided with me, I remarried for love, only to be taken abroad by that person and cruelly mu*dered, then he returned home to inherit everything I had.
On the seventh day after my death, my grave was desolate, with only my ex-husband bringing a bouquet of white roses.
When I opened my eyes again, I found myself back on the day I met my first love.

125712.synopsis:
I.  
An accident led Xi Le to discover countless Tiny People Cities appearing in his room.  
Inside the refrigerator was a city worshipping the Primordial Evil God. Beneath the bed lay a town devoted to the Evil Tree. Inside his shoe, a tribe prayed to the God of Darkness.  
At first, these Tiny People couldn’t see him, and coexistence seemed uneventful.  
But later, Xi Le realized these Tiny People Cities were actually the world he lived in—and in their eyes, he was the Crimson Moon hanging in the sky.  
II.  
After becoming the Crimson Moon, Xi Le lived freely, occasionally observing the love and hatred in Tiny People towns, helping them toss garbage into bins, offering hope to those in despair, slowly growing his believers, and striving to be a virtuous Crimson Moon.  
Until one day, a Tiny Person, hunted by Evil God Believers, prayed to the Crimson Moon—pleading for its descent and salvation from suffering.  
Out of kindness, Xi Le flicked those believers away.  
From that moment, things took a strange turn.  
III.  
This was a twisted, insane world—Evil Gods ran rampant, Sanity Points plummeted, and Contaminants infested every corner.  
The Crimson Moon hung high in the sky, casting its indifferent glow. Under its light, people grew numb and selfish, devoid of hope.  
But everything changed when the strongest person in Azure Nation, surrounded by Evil God cultists, prayed to the Crimson Moon at death’s door.  
For the first time in millennia, the world—forgotten by the God of the Red Moon—received its response.  
From then on, the Crimson Moon became everyone’s faith.  
They raved, screamed, and sacrificed everything for just a glimpse of its gaze.
associated_names: 紅月的我成為了所有人的信仰
红月的我成为了所有人的信仰

127760.synopsis:
Note: This book contains depictions of coercive relationships, forced actions, cruel behavior, and confinement. Reader discretion is advised.
I loved the Emperor. But my love was never reciprocated in the way I yearned for. With each passing day, the desire for the unattainable grew, twisting my once unwavering loyalty. Being near him was no longer enough. Driven by desperation, clinging to the slimmest hope, craving his love, I was ultimately driven to treason.

149264.synopsis:
* A flirtatious, playful, everybody’s favorite bad-girl top × a reserved, scheming, black-bellied, and extremely possessive bottom *
Shortly after school resumed following summer break, rumors began spreading at Huaizhong High School: the cold, proud top-student and student council president of the honors class, Qiao Shanwen, for some unknown reason had provoked Miss Wen from the repeater class—and had been targeted by her.
Miss Wen was trouble incarnate. She was willful, dated early, skipped classes, and was the biggest headache for the student council.
Yet even as president, Qiao Shanwen couldn’t control her. Instead, she was cornered against walls by Wen Luo, face flushed in humiliation, fleeing in embarrassment.
Forced to bring Wen Luo breakfast, forced to eat Wen Luo’s leftovers, crouching in public to tie Wen Luo’s shoelaces—someone even saw her being bullied to red-rimmed eyes and tears by Wen Luo in the broadcast room.
Even weekends and after school, all her time was taken over by Wen Luo.
Ordered around by Wen Luo, humiliated by Wen Luo.
Later, Wen Luo was sent abroad to study under her family’s arrangements, and everyone sighed in relief—Qiao Shanwen was finally free.
Later still, the Wen family mismanaged their business and went bankrupt; her mother was driven ill and hospitalized. The once carefree, indulgent Miss Wen—who spent her days eating, drinking, and partying—became the most down-and-out fallen heiress. Aside from a beautiful face, she had nothing left.
For the sake of a role she once could have obtained effortlessly, she was forced into disgraceful circumstances.
.
Many years ago, that other girl mimicked Wen Luo’s former self to sneer at her: “After all these years, how did you end up so pathetic?”
.
On another night when she was irritable and slightly drunk, Qiao Shanwen finally couldn’t hold back—grabbing Wen Luo tightly and forcing out the question that had troubled her for years: “Wen Luo, can you be a little more focused, and like only me?”
No one knew that what Wen Luo had possessed back then wasn’t only Qiao Shanwen’s time.

150032.synopsis:
I am the White Lotus(someone who maintains a façade of absolute purity, kindness, and harmlessness to hide their dark, treacherous nature) Supporting Female Character in a True and False Heiress Story.
Everyone loves me. No matter what I do, I am always right, and the Female Lead is my opposite.
Even in the Male Lead’s eyes, I am the White Moonlight(the unattainable, idealized love interest who holds a permanent, cherished spot in one’s heart), while she is just a Substitute.
It’s only when the Female Lead dies of cancer in misery that everyone suddenly realizes how much they loved her.
So, on the very first day after I transmigrated, I took the Female Lead to the hospital for a checkup: “Let’s do a gastroscopy.”
My life goes smoothly, carefree and without worries, so I wish you never get cancer again in this lifetime.

154896.synopsis:
A mansion surrounded by high walls. Everyone who comes and goes from this mansion is shrouded in secrecy.
Chairman Kwon Taekyoung, President Kwon Yicheong, and Executive Director Kwon Gakyeong of the extremely harmonious conglomerate family.
And their beloved youngest, Kwon Yoonhwa.
The extent to which they cherish the youngest was once proven when an entire news outlet was destroyed for attempting to uncover the youngest’s identity.
Employees and bodyguards joke that “even the dog raised in the mansion wouldn’t recognize their face.”
……But that statement is false.

180240.synopsis:
Huge EXP, Peak Harem! A Wholesome Rom-Com of Just a Light Touch
​In a modern world where dungeons have appeared, women possess “Levels” while men manifest “EXP.” When touched by a man, women receive experience points along with a flow of intense pleasure. I, Tatsuya, a high school student, possess a massive amount of EXP—so massive, in fact, that a mere touch causes girls to faint from ecstasy. Because of this, I had given up on ever having a girlfriend… or so I thought.
associated_names: Kiwamete KENZEN na Bishoujo Level Up
極めて健全な美少女レベルアップ
